_primary_metric_hint: The one number THIS workflow optimises — commonly impressions early, then profile visits or signups. A channel can still override it in shared/channels.json.
_comment: This folder is fully self-contained: its own experiments, sources, templates, inputs, runs and reports. Want a second social workflow with a different goal or audience? Copy this whole folder to a new name (e.g. social-partners/), rewrite this file's goal and metric, and run it independently. The folder name is the workflow name; 'type' maps it to the engine-social skill.
